verified.kill_fact: CORE EVENT SURVIVES, NUMERATOR PROVENANCE DOES NOT. Confirmed against primary text of the 2026-08-10 GlobeNewswire release (retrieved via FMP press-release feed): HF+PK results "support planned resubmission of Anaphylm NDA in the third quarter of 2026"; 17s-to-3s pouch open; >80% reduction in incorrect film placement; self-administration PK "comparable to clinician-administered." Date, terms and magnitude all verbatim, not embellished. FIRED-not-forward test PASSES: resubmission has not occurred; FDA decision is downstream. ALREADY-HARVESTED test PASSES decisively - $3.94 (Aug-7) to $4.29 (Aug-17) = +8.9%, and the stock still sits BELOW its June levels ($5.03 on 6/23) and far below pre-CRL, i.e. no announcement re-rate has been banked and 52wk-high proximity is nil. TWO CORRECTIONS THAT CUT THE SCORE. (1) The waterfall is NOT clean. The flag's "$59.0M total debt, ~$39.5M net cash, no preferred ahead of the common" reads the FMP netDebt field naively. Aquestive announced a $150 MILLION debt refinancing with Oaktree Capital on 2026-05-12 (primary GlobeNewswire headline). Q1-to-Q2 shows total debt $133.6M -> $59.0M while otherNonCurrentLiabilities jumped $6.1M -> $95.2M - the "debt reduction" the flag treated as a royalty monetization is a reclassification, not a discharge. Total liabilities $188.7M vs total assets $132.1M; stockholders' equity -$56.6M. A senior secured lender with a $150M facility sits ahead of the common; "net cash, clean waterfall" is materially overstated and the approval-case ~$8.00 equity value inherits that error. (2) HIDDEN DISQUALIFIER the flag missed entirely: a pending federal securities class action (class period 2025-06-16 to 2026-01-08, lead-plaintiff deadline 2026-05-04, Rosen/Pomerantz/Faruqi/Bronstein) alleging Aquestive CONCEALED THE ANAPHYLM NDA DEFICIENCIES now being remediated, filed after a >37% single-day drop on the Jan-8-2026 CRL. That is litigation about the exact management representations this flag is trusting - it does not refute the HF/PK data (which is objective and third-party-collected) but it materially discounts the company's forward framing and adds a contingent liability to a balance sheet already at negative equity. (3) Unverified as the flag concedes: no primary confirmation of a Class 2 designation or PDUFA date, so "roughly two quarters out" is inference. A Class 2 resubmission accepted at end-Q3-2026 carries a 6-month clock, putting action in Q1-Q2 2027 - later than the framing implies, and pushing the near-certain pre-launch equity raise squarely IN FRONT of the decision. Net: real, forward, correctly dated, genuinely unharvested catalyst on a broken balance sheet with senior secured debt and active fraud litigation. Score 7 -> 6.
verified.analysis: Verified real and forward: the 2026-08-10 GlobeNewswire release states the HF and PK results "support planned resubmission of Anaphylm NDA in the third quarter of 2026," and the specific triage claims (17s to 3s pouch-open, >80% reduction in misplacement, self-administered PK comparable to clinician-administered) are quoted verbatim from the company, so the flag is not embellished. RESIDUAL CAPTURE: run-up from the pre-catalyst base is only +8.9% ($3.94 Aug-7 close to $4.29 today; +15% from the $3.73 Jul-27 base), and remaining capture to a provenance-checked approval-case ~$8.00 is roughly +85% — this is an early-arc, largely unharvested setup, nowhere near the VISN/SLS mostly-priced pattern. NUMERATOR PROVENANCE (lighter mandate here since this is a binary_prob regulatory lane, not a derived SoP/deleveraging case, but re-derived rather than inherited from a sell-side PT): Q2-2026 10-Q (filed 2026-08-11) shows $98.5M cash, $59.0M total debt, ~$39.5M net cash and no preferred stock ahead of the common, so the waterfall is clean and the equity captures approval upside directly — but stockholders' equity is -$56.6M, the quarterly net loss was ~$22.9M, and $95.2M of other non-current liabilities appeared alongside a $74.6M debt reduction (a royalty/revenue-interest style monetization), so cash funds roughly four quarters and a pre-launch equity raise before or at PDUFA is close to certain and is the main cap on the move. Two honest gaps: I could not confirm the Class 2 designation or a PDUFA date from a primary source (web-search budget was exhausted; the Q2 release fetch timed out), and I did not read the original CRL text to confirm HF and self-administration PK were its only deficiencies — if the CRL also carried CMC or additional clinical items, the Q3 resubmission commitment stands but the approval probability is lower than the Aug-10 framing implies.
